name: Boku no Teisou o Ubawanaide!!
original_name: ボクの貞操を奪わないでっ!!
source:
The main character has been studying hard for three years to enter medical college. One day, his cousin starts living at his house to go to school nearby. Though he only slightly remembers her, he is excited to hear that. On her first day at his house.... She is quiet in front of his parents, but she soon behaves selfishly in front of him. When he is at a loss what to do, she just whispers in his ear, "Long time no see..., Shiro...." "What!?" Like this, his tragic (?) life starts....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主角为了考入医学院，刻苦学习了三年。有一天，他的表弟开始住在他家，去附近上学。虽然他只记得她一点点，但听到这个消息他很兴奋。到他家的第一天……她在他父母面前很安静，但很快在他面前就表现得自私了。当他不知所措时，她只是在他耳边低声说道：“好久不见……白……”就这样，他悲惨的（？）人生开始了……

[来自工口游戏商店]
